brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted widespread raids and home invasions across the West Bank and occupied Jerusalem overnight into Saturday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operations included arrests of Palestinians, searches of residential homes, gunfire, and the deployment of military checkpoints across multiple locations in both territories.

The campaign represented a significant expansion of Israeli military enforcement activity. Raids targeted scattered areas throughout the West Bank and East Jerusalem, with forces combining arrest operations, house-to-house searches, and checkpoint installations as part of the coordinated nighttime operation.
